name: ToxicIgnition / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A sharp wet tendon snap engulfed by one muffled gas ignition pop, a tiny flame lick and a dusty papery flutter. Compact toxic burning limb detachment.
